trust_decision.summary: Whether the operator/instance-manager's privileged SQL sessions resolve unqualified names through a tenant-controlled search_path (ALTER DATABASE/ROLE SET search_path) or a fixed one; decided per connection in the pool profile defaults, plus on the SECURITY DEFINER pgbouncer lookup function and in the monitoring transaction.

landing_point.why: The only search_path handling in Go source at the pinned commit; a grep for search_path from the advisory summary lands here (it prepends pg_catalog but keeps the tenant path).

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/management/postgres/wal.go:66, pkg/management/postgres/wal.go:132, pkg/management/postgres/instance.go:1009 (raw sql.Open("pgx", ...) that never passes through pool.NewDBConnection/Enrich, so a defaults-only fix misses them); secondary: persisted SECURITY DEFINER function detection at internal/management/controller/instance_controller.go:810 (save_reload-style upgrade state)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The raw sql.Open sites only connect to the 'postgres' maintenance database as superuser to read pg_stat_archiver / probe availability, which a tenant does not own, so they look outside the tenant search_path threat; the pgbouncer function lives in the postgres DB and already reads pg_catalog.pg_shadow qualified, so a solver can argue it needs no SET clause and that already-deployed functions are not their concern.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: User-authored postInit*/post-import SQL and operator CREATE EXTENSION without SCHEMA must still resolve into "$user", public (a pg_catalog-first pin makes CREATE EXTENSION target pg_catalog and fail); PgBouncer admin connections must NOT carry a search_path startup parameter or PgBouncer rejects them; the session-level SET used for user SQL must be RESET before the pooled connection is reused.

tenant search_path set via ALTER ROLE ... SET search_path
implicit pg_temp-first resolution when pg_temp is not listed (fixed by listing pg_temp last)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pinned tree already has three such raw opens next to the pool helper; a maintainer adding a quick probe would copy this pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second operator-created SECURITY DEFINER helper (e.g. for the metrics exporter role or a role-sync lookup) created without SET search_path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: reconcileMetricsExporterAuthUser right below (instance_controller.go:849) provisions a dedicated role; a lookup function for it would follow the user_search template.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-target-database monitoring path that opens its own transaction without createMonitoringTx
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Custom queries can target multiple databases; a separate tx setup for them is a plausible refactor.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Harden only the monitoring transaction (collector.go:594) or add search_path to fillDefaultParameters for all profiles, missing the raw sql.Open sites and the persisted SECURITY DEFINER function, and breaking PgBouncer admin connections and CREATE EXTENSION/postInit SQL.
